question.text: How will the Agit Kabayel vs. Nelson Hysa fight end on November 28, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the way the boxing match ends between Agit Kabayel and Nelson Hysa, currently scheduled for Saturday, November 28, 2026. Please note that "other outcome" includes any other outcome, including a Hysa victory, a draw, or the boxing match for any reason not being held before November 29, 2026 (local time).

research:
I couldn't find any method or round betting odds for this fight. The bookmakers only show the straight winner price, with Kabayel at about -1800 to -2000 (roughly 95% implied). The most important context: in his last six fights Kabayel stopped every opponent, between rounds 1 and 7, and Hysa is a 42-year-old who has never fought at this level.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question links a DAZN article, but it returned HTTP 403 and I couldn't read it. Its URL mentions an "IBF defence", which is wrong: every source I could read says this is a **WBC** title defence. Promoter Queensberry's event page lists it as Kabayel's first WBC heavyweight defence, on 28 Nov at the Merkur Spiel-Arena in Düsseldorf, on DAZN, with the undercard still to be announced. [Queensberry](https://queensberry.co.uk/pages/agit-kabayel-vs-nelson-hysa-bad-blood)
- The result will most likely be confirmed by DAZN, Queensberry and BoxRec reports after the fight. There is no result yet.

## 2. Current status
- 2026-10-29: Nothing has settled the question. The fight is still on, with no reports of injury, withdrawal or postponement.
- Records: Kabayel is 27-0 (19 KOs) and Hysa is 25-0 (23 KOs). [Queensberry](https://queensberry.co.uk/pages/agit-kabayel-vs-nelson-hysa-bad-blood)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)

- 2026-10-28: Filip Hrgovic is now IBF champion after stopping Moses Itauma in round 9 on 29 Aug. That is why the "IBF" label on the DAZN article looks like an error. [Punch](https://punchng.com/hrgovic-sets-conditions-for-second-itauma-clash/)

- 2026-09-28: Promoter Frank Warren said earlier that Kabayel had "backed out" of a planned meeting with Hysa. The fight was later confirmed anyway. [BoxingNews](https://boxingnews.com/news/kabayel-hysa-fight-november-dusseldorf)
- 2026-08-29: Hysa stopped Thomas Narmo (then 14-0) in round 2 in London and confronted Kabayel at ringside. Boxing News on X described Hysa as "unranked". [X/BoxingNews](https://x.com/boxingnews/status/2104698646130245743)

## 4. Base rates
Kabayel's last eight fights (all wins): [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agit_Kabayel)
- 2026-01-10: TKO round 3, Damian Knyba
- 2025-02-22: KO round 6, Zhilei Zhang
- 2024-05-18: KO round 7, Frank Sánchez
- 2023-12-23: TKO round 4, Arslanbek Makhmudov
- 2023-03-04: TKO round 3, Agron Smakici
- 2022-05-14: TKO round 1, Pavel Sour
- 2021-06-05: unanimous decision over 12 rounds, Kevin Johnson
- 2020-07-18: unanimous decision over 10 rounds, Evgenios Lazaridis

How the last six stoppages fall into the answer bands: 3 in rounds 1-3, 2 in rounds 4-6, 1 in rounds 7-12. Over his whole career he has stopped 19 of 27 opponents (70%), so 8 fights went to a decision.

Hysa:
- He turned pro late (around age 37, in 2022) and has stopped his last 18 opponents. [Boxing News Online](https://boxingnewsonline.net/news/agit-kabayel-confronted-by-ko-artist/)
- Notable opponents: Patrick Korte, Edwin Castillo (KO round 3), Abel Pesut (retired in round 3, Oct 2025) and Narmo. None are top-level. [Boxing Showtimes](https://boxingshowtimes.com/boxers/nelson-the-albanian-eagle-hysa)
- I couldn't find any record of Hysa going past round 3 or 4 against a strong opponent, or of him ever being knocked down.

- There is no Polymarket or Manifold market on this fight.

- Fight week, around 24-27 Nov: weigh-in and medicals. Any late withdrawal or postponement would count as "Other outcome". Hysa is 42, so injury risk matters, and Warren's earlier pull-out claim shows plans between these two have fallen through before.

- Hysa is 25-0 with 23 KOs. His recent wins over Narmo and Korte were both R2 stoppages. Against weak opposition he has rarely, possibly never, gone past round 2. I could not confirm his longest fight. He is 42, and his best names before Narmo were Danny Williams and Pavel Sour.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About one month remains. The fight is on 28 November 2026 and the result will be known that night, around 29 November 00:00 UTC.

(b) If nothing changes, the fight goes ahead and Kabayel, a heavy favourite at roughly -1800 to -2000, most likely stops Hysa.

(c) Base rates:
- Kabayel has stopped 70% of his career opponents.
- He has stopped his last six opponents. Three were in rounds 1-3, two in rounds 4-6 and one in round 7.
- His two most recent decisions were in 2020-21.
- Generally, about 3-6% of scheduled heavyweight title fights fall through in the final month.
- The bookmaker's implied chance for a Hysa win, after removing the margin, is about 5-7%.

(d) Strongest evidence:
- Bookmaker prices (snippets seen October 2026) put Kabayel at -1800 to -2000.
- Kabayel stopped Knyba in round 3 (January 2026) and Zhang in round 6 (February 2025).
- Hysa is 42, unranked and has never fought at this level. He stopped his last 18 opponents, all early, including Narmo in round 2 on 29 August 2026.
- As of 28-29 October the fight is confirmed, with over 40,000 tickets sold and no injury reports.
- Warren claimed on 28 September that Kabayel had "backed out" of a meeting, but this did not stop the fight being confirmed.

(e) Unexpected scenario: Hysa, a big puncher with an untested chin, rushes Kabayel early and lands a counter in round 2 to cause a huge upset. Alternatively, Hysa gets injured in camp at 42 and the fight is postponed into 2027.

Reasoning: I started from the market's roughly 94% for a Kabayel win. I lowered that to about 88% to cover cancellation or postponement (around 4%), a draw or no contest (around 1%) and an upset (around 6-7%).

Within a Kabayel win, I weighted early stoppages more heavily because:
- Hysa's level of opposition is much lower than Zhang's or Sánchez's.
- Hysa's aggressive, come-forward style invites exchanges.
- At 42, his durability over many rounds is doubtful.

Kabayel's body-punching style still often produces stoppages in the middle rounds. I left a modest share on a decision in case Hysa proves durable and cautious.
